Best Mexican and owner!
Nov 2024 • Couples
New edit- Now the Viva Masterchef has real salsa with fresh tomatoes 🍅, onions 🧅, and cilantro 🌿(coriander) added to his delicious red sauce and real pico de gallo made fresh daily!! This is not only the best Mexican in Ninh Bình, it is also the best Pizza 🍕!!! The owner Mr. Romeo and his excellent Big Brother Mr. Nghia (strong family business) and Masterchef 👨‍🍳 Mr. Trang were trained in 5-star resorts and have been taught by many Mexicans from Mexico to make delicious Mexican food! Italians and Americans taught them Pizza! Do yourself a favor if you are a Westerner or Vietnamese and choose to eat this delicious food today! Edit- If you are a vegan or vegetarian, this might not be your best option. Go to a Vietnamese place with the word “Chay” or Indian food. If you are a vegetarian or vegan, you can come here but make sure you speak to the owner Romeo, and ask for some of the Brandon special salsa or extra flavor.
